verses.ya-khaliqan-lima-yasha-c1-v1: yā khāliqā limā yashā fīmā yashā kayfa yashā
verses.ya-khaliqan-lima-yasha-c1-v2: wamuʿṭiyā limā yashā wamāniʿā limā yashā
verses.ya-khaliqan-lima-yasha-c1-v3: ʾin lam tuqaddir mā nashā faṭ-ṭuf binā fīmā tashā
verses.ya-khaliqan-lima-yasha-c1-v4: kaylā yakūna mā nashā khilāfa mā ʾanta tashā
